meta.name: sns
meta.description: AWS SNS notification service for pub/sub messaging. Use when creating topics, managing subscriptions, configuring message filtering, sending notifications, or setting up mobile push.

copy.tagline: 管理 AWS SNS 主题、订阅和推送通知
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 AWS 上搭建发布/订阅消息系统
copy.tagline_en: Manage AWS SNS topics, subscriptions, and push notifications
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up pub/sub messaging on AWS

howto.what: Claude 可以帮你创建和管理 AWS SNS 主题、订阅、发布消息，并配置消息过滤策略。
howto.when: 当你需要设置发布/订阅消息通知，或管理 AWS SNS 主题、订阅、消息过滤时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 SNS 主题，并订阅一个 Lambda 函数。
say.note: Claude 会生成创建主题和订阅的代码。

say.text: 发布一条带属性的消息到 SNS 主题。
say.note: Claude 会生成发布消息的代码，包含消息属性。

say.text: 为 SNS 订阅添加过滤策略，只接收 order_created 事件。
say.note: Claude 会生成设置过滤策略的命令。

howto.what_en: Claude can help you create and manage AWS SNS topics, subscriptions, publish messages, and configure message filtering policies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to set up pub/sub messaging notifications or manage AWS SNS topics, subscriptions, or message filtering.

say_en.text: Create an SNS topic and subscribe a Lambda function.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code for topic creation and subscription.

say_en.text: Publish a message with attributes to an SNS topic.
say_en.note: Claude will generate publish code with message attributes.

say_en.text: Add a filter policy to an SNS subscription to only receive order_created events.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the command to set the filter policy.
